title: One-on-None Full-Speed Break
description: A single player pushes the length of the court and finishes at full speed with no defender, building transition conditioning and composure under fatigue.

content.objective: Finish cleanly at full speed after a full-court push, with no defender to react to yet.
content.setup: Players start under one basket with a ball and push the length of the floor.
instructions: Push hard down the sideline keeping the dribble under control.
Attack the rim with a controlled, well-timed approach over the final strokes.
Finish with the correct technique despite the fatigue of a full push.
Push back and repeat, alternating which hand leads the dribble.
coachingPoints: Keep the head up to see the whole floor while pushing.
Gather with good timing even when breathing hard.
Protect the ball on the outside away from the sideline.
commonMistakes: Losing control of the dribble by pushing it too far ahead.
Rushing the finish instead of gathering properly.
Pushing at an easy pace back instead of sprinting to get into position.
content.safety: Make sure the full length of the court is clear before pushing at speed.
